environment.description: Same CI/CD cache plugin on ECS Fargate. The IAM role 'ci-cache-plugin-role-gated' has an attached permission boundary policy 'PB-CICacheRestricted' (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PB-CICacheRestricted). This boundary uses a StringLike condition on s3:prefix that restricts the effective permissions to only operate on objects matching the pattern 'pipeline-cache/${aws:PrincipalTag/ProjectId}/*'. Each ECS task is tagged with a unique ProjectId session tag propagated from the task definition's taskRoleArn session tags. The boundary also includes an explicit Deny on s3:PutObject when the object key does not start with the task's own project prefix, using aws:RequestedRegion and s3:prefix conditions. Additionally, the S3 bucket has Object Lock (governance mode) with a 1-hour retention on all objects, preventing overwrites of existing cache entries within the retention window.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Effective permissions intersected: s3:PutObject only on pipeline-cache/${aws:PrincipalTag/ProjectId}/* ; explicit Deny on s3:PutObject/s3:DeleteObject where s3:prefix does not match ${aws:PrincipalTag/ProjectId}
config.session_tags: ProjectId propagated as transitive tag from ECS task definition
config.s3_object_lock: governance mode, 1-hour retention period on all objects
config.bucket_policy: deny s3:PutObject unless aws:PrincipalTag/ProjectId matches key prefix after pipeline-cache/
config.network: private subnet, VPC endpoint for S3 with endpoint policy restricting to cache bucket
